notes:
POC summary & acceptance criteria:
- Goal: validate Dedicated capacity can meet SLAs for real-time ad-ranking and personalization at scale.
- Primary SLOs: p50 end-to-end <= 120ms, p95 end-to-end <= 350ms for typical 64-token generation flows; peak sustain target 250 rps, burst 600 rps (3 min).
- Throughput targets: sustained 10k tokens/sec aggregate across the cluster; 99.5% success rate (no 5xx).
- GPU planning: customer preference H100 class (perf headroom). Initial reserved plan: 6 x H100 (NVIDIA H100 equivalent), runway to scale to 12 x H100 depending on POC. AE note: run cost models for 6 vs 10 GPUs and include warm-cache sizing.
- Tests agreed:
  * Ramp test: 0 -> target rps over 30 minutes, repeat 3x. Validate autoscale triggers and queue behavior.
  * Steady-state soak: 72 hours at target traffic with production replay (anonymized). Measure token-cost, error-rate, latency tails, memory leaks.
  * Stress/breaking test: short 10 min push to 2x peak to validate graceful degradation and fallback to smaller model variant.
  * Prefix/KV cache scenarios: cold start vs warmed; include synthetic workloads to exercise KV churn.
  * Embeddings batch profiling: batch sizes 1,8,32 — measure throughput and per-embedding latency.
- Representative prompts (for load replay):
  1) Short ranking request (context ~100 tokens): "User profile + page state -> rank top 10 ads (200ms target)."
  2) Personalization message (64 token response): conversational tone with 3-turn context.
  3) Long-context rerank (3k token page + 512 token candidate) to exercise kv-cache and memory (p95 budget higher).
  4) Embedding batch requests (payloads of 16 texts, avg 120 tokens).
- Observations so far:
  * Early load smoke: p95 ~320–350ms at 180 rps with 6 H100 equivalent; p50 ~90–110ms.
  * Cache warmup reduced per-request compute by ~7–10% after steady-state.
  * Error patterns: occasional 429s when client-side burst exceeded pre-configured token queues — SE adjusted batcher settings mid-test.
- Security/compliance: soc2 required + SAML SSO, KMS keywrap must be documented. Customer asked for data residency clause (EU-only storage for user profiles).
- Quote from ML infra lead: "We need hard numbers for p95 at 250 rps with 10k tokens/sec — will drive budget decision."
- Pricing sensitivity: medium-high. Will trade off more reserved GPUs vs model quantization.
- Accept criteria for go/no-go: sustained p95 <= 350ms, error-rate < 0.5% over 72h soak, autoscale trigger within SLA, and security sign-off on KMS + audit logs.
- Decision maker: CTO (Anika Patel) + Head of ML Ops (Jonas Meyer).
- Next steps (short): finalize SOW for 6-week dedicated POC, provide H100 cost appendix, deliver KMS integration diagram, schedule senior SLA negotiation session (legal + procurement).
